confirmed_additions.card_hook: Holiday shopping and live music, with optional Highland calf visits.
confirmed_additions.editorial_summary: A December 13 holiday market with more than 100 vendors, the Greg Warren Band, food and seasonal drinks. Entry to shop and parking are free. Regular farm attractions are not operating during the market. Mistletoe & Moo's is a separately ticketed add-on, with $20 nonalcoholic and $25 age 21+ options; it is not included with market entry.
confirmed_additions.verify_note: Date, 9 PM finish, free market and optional paid calf encounters verified on organizer page. Start time deliberately null due to 4 PM versus 5 PM conflict.
confirmed_additions.schedule_note: December 13. Organizer sources conflict on the start: dedicated event page says 4 PM, calendar and supplied organizer post say 5 PM. Confirm before traveling; both list a 9 PM finish.

confirmed_additions.parking_tip: Official FAQ lists standard parking at $19 per vehicle and preferred at $24, tax included. Confirm current parking terms when booking.

The supplied Centro Ybor post advertises music, holiday lights, falling snow and Santa and Mrs. Claus. It also describes a limited Centro Cash gift for the first 350 attendees, rather than a guaranteed gift for every visitor.
confirmed_additions.verify_note: Chamber verifies November 18, 2026, 6 to 9 PM. Free entry, snow, 7 PM lighting and limited $10 Centro Cash promotion come from supplied venue-owned IMG_6083/6084 posts; do not universalize promotion.

confirmed_additions.card_hook: A free community holiday afternoon with optional paid Santa photos.
confirmed_additions.editorial_summary: The town's current event page lists December 12 from 2 to 9 PM at Clarke House Park. Admission and many activities, including train and hay rides through the lighted trail, are free. A digital Santa photo costs extra, so free entry does not mean every activity is included.
confirmed_additions.parking_tip: Town lists parking across Kingsley Avenue at First Baptist Church, with limited accessible parking inside the park.
confirmed_additions.verify_note: Current town event page and Historical Society agree on December 12, 2 to 9 PM. Older town location calendar not used.
confirmed_additions.schedule_note: December 12 only, 2 to 9 PM. Current exact event page supersedes stale location-calendar text showing December 12 to 13.

confirmed_additions.editorial_summary: Vintage Market Days of Jacksonville runs December 4 to 6 at Clay County Fairgrounds, with vintage and inspired art, home decor, clothing, jewelry and makers. This is separate from Diamonds in the Rust at Diamond D Ranch. Children under 12 are free, and a purchased ticket allows re-entry during the weekend.

confirmed_additions.event_name: Diamonds in the Rust Fall Market
confirmed_additions.short_title: Diamonds in the Rust Fall Market
confirmed_additions.card_hook: A November vintage market at Diamond D Ranch.
confirmed_additions.editorial_summary: The ranch's fall market runs November 20 to 22, 10 AM to 4 PM, with vintage and maker shopping. Admission is $15 on Friday and $10 on Saturday or Sunday, tax included; children under 12 are free. This November market is not the December Vintage Market Days event at Clay County Fairgrounds.
confirmed_additions.parking_tip: Complimentary parking and shuttles are listed. Optional VIP parking is separate from admission.
confirmed_additions.verify_note: Dates/hours/prices verified on operator event page. Street address from official Visit Jacksonville destination listing; root should open destination source to confirm address before pinning.
confirmed_additions.schedule_note: November 20 to 22, 10 AM to 4 PM daily.

confirmed_additions.card_hook: Reserve a 75-minute skate with rentals included.
confirmed_additions.editorial_summary: Artist Walk on Ice lists 75-minute skating sessions with skate rental included, from November 27 to January 18. Online general admission is $18 per person plus taxes and fees. Reservations apply to the selected date and time, so the base price is not an all-in under-$20 promise.
confirmed_additions.parking_tip: Operator lists complimentary parking at Riverside Arts Market lot, 729 Riverside Ave, and Florida Blue garage, 532 Riverside Ave. The rink entrance is 718 Riverside Ave.
confirmed_additions.verify_note: Official sources checked 2026-11-17. See companion evidence_checks for remaining limitations.
confirmed_additions.schedule_note: Monday to Thursday 4 to 9 PM; Friday 4 to 10 PM; Saturday 10 AM to 10 PM; Sunday 10 AM to 8 PM. Check holiday exceptions and available sessions.
